title: Mixed Assign/Add Tags
prompt:
**Bài toán.** `1 l r v` assigns v; `2 l r v` adds v; `3 l r` prints the
sum of [l, r].

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n, q ≤ 2·10^5; |v| ≤ 10^9.

Compose order matters: assign kills pending adds; add after assign must
survive later pushes.

tests.name: assign then add
tests.hint: Assign [1,5,5,4] then +3 on [1,1]: [4,5,5,4] sums 18 — add must survive the assign's tag-clear.

tests.name: add then assign
add, assign, then re-query
tests.hint: Pending add [1,2]+5, then assign-all 0: node [1,2] must push the stale add before the assign overwrites it; then +7 on [2,2] gives sum 7, pos1 stays 0.

tests.name: n=200000 shuffle
tests.hint: Assign(5) + add(+1) → every whole sum is 6·2·10^5 = 12·10^5. Compose-order bugs drift here.
